nodes.label: Caveman Compress Skill
nodes.rationale: Compresses natural-language memory files into caveman-speak to cut input tokens; the compressed version overwrites the original so the file Claude actually reads is the small one.

nodes.label: Validate-and-Cherry-Pick Compression Pipeline
nodes.rationale: detect type -> compress -> validate (headings, code blocks, URLs, file paths, bullets) -> cherry-pick targeted fixes only, never a recompression -> retry up to 2 times -> if still failing, report and leave the original untouched. Patching only broken parts avoids a second full-file token spend and stops a retry from introducing new drift.

nodes.label: Out-of-Tree Original Backup
nodes.rationale: The human-readable FILE.original.md backup lives in $XDG_DATA_HOME/caveman-compress/backups/<parent-dir-name>/ (or %LOCALAPPDATA%\caveman-compress\backups\<parent-dir-name>\ on Windows) rather than beside the source, so skill auto-loaders do not re-ingest the uncompressed copy as a live file — which would cancel the token saving.

nodes.label: Code Regions Are Read-Only
nodes.rationale: Fenced and inline code must be copied exactly — no removing comments or spacing, no reordering, no shortening commands. URLs, file paths, commands, technical terms, proper nouns, dates, versions and environment variables are likewise preserved verbatim; headings keep exact text while only the body beneath is compressed.

nodes.label: Compressible File-Type Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Only .md/.txt/.rst/.typ/.typst/.tex and extensionless prose are compressed; code and config (.py/.js/.ts/.json/.yaml/.toml/.env/.lock/.css/.html/.xml/.sql/.sh) are never modified; mixed files have prose compressed only; anything ambiguous is left unchanged; *.original.md is always skipped.

nodes.label: python3 -m scripts CLI Entry Point
nodes.rationale: Invoked from the directory containing SKILL.md with an absolute filepath; the compression scripts live in scripts/ adjacent to SKILL.md, discoverable via scripts/__main__.py.
